sections.Profile:
The "Club House" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation in November 1958, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game with a golf theme. Designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin, the machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, three kick-out holes, and a gobble hole.
